text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze sweeps across Tokyo 
Racecourse.

Predicting that Ines Fujin could run away 
with the lead even on today's long
course, 
Mejiro Ryan steeled her resolve to give
it her all and chase her down.

Meanwhile, Ines Fujin, anticipating that 
she would definitely catch up, fired 
herself up to front-run and hold her lead 
to the end.

Ines Fujin in the lead,
and Mejiro Ryan in 
hot pursuit. Now,
the two of them—clash on 
the grand stage!
